changelog:
Initial release of article-organizer-builder.

- Generates a fully customized "article collection and organization" Skill for Obsidian users, based on interactive user input.
- Reads construction standards from references/builder-prompt.md and guides users to provide personalized paths, classification rules, and note title preferences.
- Automatically produces a ready-to-use Skill directory under ~/.workbuddy/skills/ without altering any existing skills.
- Ensures generated scripts use only the Python standard library and enforce safety measures (no out-of-scope deletion, safe archiving).
- Provides users with clear instructions, directory overview, and validation checklist for setup confirmation.
summary: 生成器技能（元技能）——专为 Obsidian 用户设计：当用户想构建/生成一个「文章收藏整理」类 Skill（把公众号/网页文章批量提炼为结构化笔记、按主题分类归档进 vault 收藏夹、三依据去重防重复收藏、清理源文件）时使用； 生成的笔记自动带 frontmatter 标签、相关笔记双链与单一总索引 MOC，直接织入 Obsidian 知识图谱。 也用于把个人化的收藏整理 skill 转换为可复用的通用模板。触发词：构建收藏整理skill、生成文章整理skill、 收藏整理skill怎么做、做一个文章归档skill、obsidian收藏整理、article organizer skill
